name: GBM - Magazine Live Issue v6.2R (restored stable)

embedData.html:
<style id="gbm-magazine-editorial-v7">html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #SITE_PAGES{display:none!important}
/* The replaced Wix magazine canvas must not extend beyond its zero-height host. */
html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #pageBackground_nh0hy{display:none!important}
html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #SITE_CONTAINER,html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #masterPage,html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #PAGES_CONTAINER,html:has(#gbm-magazine-page) #SITE_PAGES_TRANSITION_GROUP{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding-bottom:0!important;margin-bottom:0!important}
#gbm-magazine-page,#gbm-magazine-page *{box-sizing:border-box}
#gbm-magazine-page{--n:#11274a;--b:#0021a5;--o:#e84b10;--m:#5f6b80;--l:#d9dee7;background:#fffdf9;color:#11274a;font:15px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;padding:24px 0 0;position:relative;z-index:3}
#gbm-magazine-page a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){#gbm-magazine-page a:hover h1,#gbm-magazine-page a:hover h3,#gbm-magazine-page a:hover b,#gbm-magazine-page a:hover strong{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}}
#gbm-magazine-page a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--o);outline-offset:4px}
#gbm-magazine-page .wrap{max-width:1184px;margin:auto;padding:0 24px 40px}
#gbm-magazine-page .issue{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--m)}
#gbm-magazine-page .cover{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:0 32px;border-block:3px solid var(--n);padding:16px 0 24px}
#gbm-magazine-page .top{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--m)}
#gbm-magazine-page .mast{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--l);padding:20px 0;margin-bottom:24px;color:var(--n);font:700 30px/1 Georgia,serif}
#gbm-magazine-page .mast img{width:240px;height:auto;display:block}
#gbm-magazine-page .hero{grid-column:1;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#edf0f3;overflow:hidden;align-self:start}
#gbm-magazine-page .hero img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead{grid-column:2;align-self:center}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead small{color:#ba3c0c;font:700 10px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead h1{margin:12px 0 16px;font:700 36px/1.1 Georgia,serif!important;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--n)!important}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead p{font:15px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--m);margin:0}
#gbm-magazine-page .lines{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;margin-top:26px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--l)}
#gbm-magazine-page .line b{display:block;font:700 21px/1.2 Georgia,serif}
#gbm-magazine-page .line span{display:none}
#gbm-magazine-page .inside{margin-top:32px}
#gbm-magazine-page .inside .ey{color:#ba3c0c;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700}
#gbm-magazine-page .inside>h2{font:700 30px/1.15 Georgia,serif!important;margin:8px 0 24px;color:var(--n)!important}
#gbm-magazine-page .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px 24px}
#gbm-magazine-page .card{min-width:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--l);padding-bottom:20px}
#gbm-magazine-page .art{aspect-ratio:16/10;background:#edf0f3;overflow:hidden}
#gbm-magazine-page .art img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct{padding-top:14px}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct h3{font:700 22px/1.2 Georgia,serif!important;color:var(--n)!important;margin:0}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct p{color:var(--m);font:13px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;margin:10px 0 0}
#gbm-magazine-page .refs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;margin-top:32px;border-top:3px solid var(--o);padding-top:22px}
#gbm-magazine-page .refs span{color:#ba3c0c;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em}
#gbm-magazine-page .refs strong{display:block;font:700 23px/1.2 Georgia,serif;margin-top:8px}
#gbm-magazine-page .refs em{display:block;color:var(--m);font:13px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:820px){
#gbm-magazine-page{padding-top:16px}
#gbm-magazine-page .wrap{padding:0 18px 30px}
#gbm-magazine-page .cover{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
#gbm-magazine-page .mast{font-size:23px;gap:12px;padding-block:15px;margin-bottom:18px}
#gbm-magazine-page .mast img{width:min(170px,46vw);min-width:0}
#gbm-magazine-page .mast{gap:10px;font-size:clamp(20px,5.8vw,23px)}
#gbm-magazine-page .hero{grid-column:1;aspect-ratio:16/10;max-height:320px}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead{grid-column:1;margin-top:18px}
#gbm-magazine-page .lead h1{font-size:28px!important;line-height:1.15!important}
#gbm-magazine-page .lines{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
#gbm-magazine-page .line{border-bottom:1px solid var(--l);padding-bottom:16px}
#gbm-magazine-page .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
#gbm-magazine-page .card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px}
#gbm-magazine-page .art{aspect-ratio:1;align-self:start}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct{padding:0}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct h3{font-size:19px!important}
#gbm-magazine-page .ct p{display:none}
#gbm-magazine-page .refs{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
}
</style><script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Presidente49/gatorbait-media-redesign@5412b47dc2da4fe5e25676bde65145454aacd891/automation/site-design/magazine.js"></script>
